name: PixelCard-TS-TW
title: Pixel Reveal Card
description: A canvas-based card where pixels gradually appear on hover and disappear on blur. Individual pixels animate in a wave pattern based on distance from center. Supports four color variants (default, blue, yellow, pink). Respects…
use: Interactive showcase cards where the reveal animation creates visual interest.
avoid: Accessibility-first contexts: no keyboard equivalent for the reveal effect without focus styles.
a11y: Card is tabbable (tabIndex=0 by default). Focus triggers the same reveal as hover. Respects prefers-reduced-motion.
